title: Color contrast — text meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratios
objective: Verify that text and UI elements meet minimum contrast ratios against their backgrounds: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and UI components.

source.description: Design tokens in theme.css define color pairs that must meet WCAG contrast thresholds — status badges and accent colors are common failure points

execution.criteria: Check all text/background color pairs from theme.css against WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratio requirements. Focus on status badges, accent text, muted text, and text-on-elevated-background
execution.expected_outcome: Primary text on primary background >= 4.5:1, status badge text on badge background >= 3:1

pass_criteria.description: Status indicator text on status background meets 3:1 minimum
Accent color links on background meet 3:1
